sources.name: PeopleGroups.org Public API
sources.provider: Global Research Department of the International Mission Board
sources.publicRedistribution: No static corpus mirror or Unreached bulk-data API. Provider data is accessed through the provider's public read-only API and is not relicensed by Unreached.
sources.cacheStatus: device-local validated resilience cache plus bounded device-private mission-history transitions; never synced, exported, or publicly redistributed
sources.attributionText: Data provided and maintained by the Global Research Department of the International Mission Board via PeopleGroups.org
requirements: preserve PeopleGroups.org / IMB attribution and source provenance
treat the public API as an external runtime dependency and fail closed on incompatible schema or pagination changes
preserve source-native GSEC and resource semantics instead of manufacturing Joshua Project fields or stronger Scripture milestones
do not expose a static or downloadable mirror of the full provider corpus
do not claim ownership of or relicense PeopleGroups.org data
keep any resilience cache private to the user's browser and separate from the public service-worker asset cache
do not reuse provider-linked or third-party photos without separate item-level rights review
re-review the beta API documentation before releases that materially change provider access or caching
historical observations may persist only on-device as a bounded private log and must remain excluded from private sync, server storage, exports and public redistribution
store only source-returned mission fields plus source UpdatedDate and local observation times; do not backfill, interpolate or infer past source states
de-duplicate consecutive repeated observations of the same tracked mission state so repeat visits do not manufacture time-series points, while later reversions remain visible
provider-hosted historical GSEC overview PDFs may be linked for research context but must not be copied or parsed into an Unreached historical dataset without a separate rights and methodology review
sources.permissionGate: Phase 14 re-reviewed the current PeopleGroups.org public API and Research Data pages on 2026-09-19. The API remains a free public read-only runtime source and documents UpdatedDate for source records. PeopleGroups.org separately publishes historical GSEC overview PDFs for 2011–2024 and says that aggregate archive is no longer currently updated. Phase 14 links to that provider-hosted archive but does not copy or reinterpret it as individual PGID revision history. Per-record historical intelligence is approved only as a bounded device-private observation history created from ordinary runtime reads; no public snapshot archive, bulk export, server history service, provider mirror or inferred backfill is introduced.

sources.name: Natural Earth

sources.name: Joshua Project Data API
sources.publicRedistribution: Phase 13 permits only narrow on-demand display of manually crosswalked records as a value-added source comparison. No static corpus mirror, bulk endpoint, downloadable snapshot or provider replacement service is permitted.
sources.cacheStatus: on-demand pass-through only; no Worker, application-corpus or browser persistence; responses use HTTP no-store
requirements: non-commercial use
visible linked attribution on every page displaying Joshua Project content
no direct replication or highly overlapping public service
provide meaningful value-add through source comparison and methodology explanation rather than repackaging Joshua Project content
serve only manually reviewed provider identity crosswalks; do not fuzzy-match names or assume numeric identifier equivalence
preserve source-native LeastReached classification rather than recalculating it from rounded percentage fields
do not average, merge or silently reconcile Joshua Project classifications with PeopleGroups.org / IMB classifications
do not persist Joshua Project API responses in Worker storage, the application corpus, service-worker caches or browser persistence
delete any downloaded or cached data if API access is terminated
keep the Joshua Project API credential exclusively in a server-side secret and never expose it to browser code or repository history
sources.permissionGate: Phase 13 re-reviewed the current Joshua Project API terms and documentation on 2026-09-17. A narrow post-3.0 comparison integration is approved only on the Phase 13 branch: three manually reviewed PGIC identity links, on-demand no-store requests through the Worker, minimal returned fields, visible linked attribution and no bulk/corpus persistence. The branch remains blocked by V3 Gate D until Unreached 3.0 is certified and shipped, and production activation additionally requires the JOSHUA_PROJECT_API_KEY Worker secret.
